Conversion/LocalizationEntryParserUtils..description: Utility to build a localization table from json, intended to be used with rojo. Can also handle Rojo json objects turned into tables! Public entry points include `LocalizationEntryParserUtils.decodeFromInstance`, `LocalizationEntryParserUtils.decodeFromTable`.

JSONTranslator.luau.description: Utility function that loads a translator from a folder or a table. To get translations uploaded. 1. Run the game 2. On the client, check LocalizationService.GeneratedJSONTable 3. Right click > Save as CSV 4. Stop the game 5. In Studio, go to plugins > "Localization Tools" 6.

Numbers/NumberLocalizationUtils.luau.description: NumberLocalizationUtils script from Roblox's player scripts in handling the leaderboard. Example locale-sensitive number formatting: https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E19455-01/806-0169/overview-9/index.html Locale specification: List section = abbreviations for language, in increasing order Missing features in this code: - No support for differences in number of digits per GROUP_DELIMITER.

Numbers/RoundingBehaviourTypes.luau.description: Rounding Behaviour Types provides the class/model implementation used by the Clientranslator package.

TranslatorService.luau.description: Handles selecting the right locale/translator for Studio, and Roblox games. Public entry points include `TranslatorService.Init`, `TranslatorService.GetLocalizationTable`, `TranslatorService.ObserveTranslator`, `TranslatorService.PromiseTranslator`, `TranslatorService.GetTranslator`, `TranslatorService.ObserveLocaleId`, `TranslatorService.GetLocaleId`, `TranslatorService.Destroy`.

Utils/LocalizationServiceUtils.luau.description: Localization Service Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Clientranslator package. Public entry points include `LocalizationServiceUtils.promiseTranslatorForLocale`, `LocalizationServiceUtils.promisePlayerTranslator`.

Utils/PseudoLocalize.luau.description: Pseudo localizes text. Useful for verifying translation without having actual translations available Public entry points include `PseudoLocalize.pseudoLocalize`, `PseudoLocalize.getDefaultPseudoLocaleId`, `PseudoLocalize.addToLocalizationTable`.

Utils/TranslationKeyUtils.luau.description: Translation Key Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Clientranslator package. Public entry points include `TranslationKeyUtils.getTranslationKey`.
